title: Family mourning 60-year-old man murdered on Father's Day.
text:
The Bexar County Sheriff's Office is searching for answers about a heartless Father’s Day murder.60-year-old David Verdecanna’s family says he was working hard
The Bexar County Sheriff's Office is searching for answers about a heartless Father’s Day murder. 60-year-old David Verdecanna’s family says he was working hard on Father’s Day to fix his son’s car before going out to celebrate his big day with his family, but he was murdered before he could make it home.
Verdecanna was found shot in the head Sunday outside his shop on Highway 181 near Foster Road. He leaves behind five children and seven grandchildren.
“He was always looking to help out people,” Verdecanna said. “If he saw someone broken down on the side of the road he would help them. My dad has even housed people inside of his warehouse to get them off the street. He was an amazing person.
” Verdecanna’s wife was out running errands while he replaced their son’s water pump. Sheriff Salazar says she called deputies to her husband’s business where he was found with multiple gunshot wounds.
“I didn’t get a chance to say happy Father’s Day to him,” Verdecanna said. “We sent him a text message but there was no response. It’s just heartbreaking. ” Verdecanna’s family is heartbroken, but they are fighting through the pain, wanting to know who would want to steal their father from them.
